notification-panel.purpose: Collect operational alerts, approvals, sync issues, and risk notices in a prioritized review surface tied to a notification trigger.
useWhen: Users need to review multiple alerts without leaving the current process.
Notifications have priority, read/unread state, timestamps, and actions.
A topbar or shell slot needs a count-backed panel.
doNotUseWithoutReview: A single transient message would be better as Toast.
Read/unread, priority, routing, or action ownership is unclear.
The panel becomes a task inbox without escalation rules.
foundations: Defines panel width, list density, action placement, and responsive drawer fallback.
Owns alert titles, timestamps, action labels, and empty/read state copy.
Controls unread emphasis, priority tone, selected item, and action states.
Panel floats from shell and separates from page content.
Unread, read, priority, loading, empty, dismissed, and actioned states are explicit.
Trigger count, panel label, keyboard list access, Escape close, and live updates are required.
slots: Shows count and opens panel after user action.
Resolve, review, mark all read, or open detail.
Shown when no notifications need attention.
Panel floats on desktop and can become drawer/sheet on small viewports.
variants: Icon button with count-backed actionable unread list.
Empty State when no items remain.
Panel moves to drawer/sheet with close path after mobile work starts.
motion: Opens after trigger and closes with Escape or outside action.
Resolved rows update without hiding context.
Action feedback is transient and non-blocking.
accessibility: Notification trigger exposes count text, not color only.
Keyboard users can review and action items.
Empty state is announced when the list becomes empty.
tests: Icon Button trigger opens and closes the panel.
Mark all read updates list and count.
Empty state appears when no notifications remain.
Mobile fallback preserves close and focus behavior.

canDecide: Use Notification Panel when multiple alerts need review.
Choose popover or drawer from viewport and shell rules.
Show empty state after all notifications are read.
mustAsk: Notification source, priority, read state, routing, or action ownership is unclear.
Notifications affect approvals, finance, compliance, security, or legal state.
rejectIf: A single message should be Toast.
Actions do not declare owner or result feedback.
miel.handoff: Confirm trigger, count source, priority model, read state, action ownership, routing, and mobile fallback.
